mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and fall in the unemployment rate signals aggressive monetary tightening during labor market strength, increasing equity risk premiums and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1000 thousand units signals robust consumer demand, accelerating earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle periods when HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month growth trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS grows for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals broad-based economic expansion, accelerating corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 signals strengthening manufacturing activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate investment accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-recession recovery periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.
